name: authorized-connectors-bot
description: Automation bot that logs into a web app in an incognito session and authorizes all connector actions.

scripts.test:mock: TARGET_URL=http://localhost:5599/ LOGIN_EMAIL=tester@example.com LOGIN_PASSWORD=secret123 HEADLESS=true BROWSER_CHANNEL= USE_INCOGNITO_WINDOW=false SLOW_MO=0 MANUAL_STEP_TIMEOUT=0 SCREENSHOTS=false node src/index.js --single
scripts.test:verify: TARGET_URL=http://localhost:5599/ LOGIN_EMAIL=tester@example.com LOGIN_PASSWORD=secret123 HEADLESS=true BROWSER_CHANNEL= USE_INCOGNITO_WINDOW=false SLOW_MO=0 MANUAL_STEP_TIMEOUT=0 SCREENSHOTS=false node src/index.js --single --verify-only
scripts.test:parallel: TARGET_URL=http://localhost:5599/ HEADLESS=true BROWSER_CHANNEL= USE_INCOGNITO_WINDOW=false SLOW_MO=0 MANUAL_STEP_TIMEOUT=0 SCREENSHOTS=false BATCH_DELAY=1000 node src/batch.js --csv=mock/users.csv --parallel=3
scripts.test:ui: TARGET_URL=http://localhost:5599/ HEADLESS=true BROWSER_CHANNEL= USE_INCOGNITO_WINDOW=false SLOW_MO=0 MANUAL_STEP_TIMEOUT=0 SCREENSHOTS=true BATCH_DELAY=1000 node src/ui/server.js --csv=mock/users.csv
